newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE RANKS 28TH AMONG 58 COUNTRIES IN STATE CORRUPTION-DEPUTY.
newsitem.headline: GREECE RANKS 28TH AMONG 58 COUNTRIES IN STATE CORRUPTION-DEPUTY.

text.p: Greece ranked 28th among 54 countries in a recent survey by the international organisation against corruption, Transperancy International, said conservative New Democracy party deputy Manolis Kefalogiannis.

Kefaloyiannis critised the socialist government for sending just three procurement contracts, each worth over 1.0 billion drachmas, for legal approval to the state council before signing them since October 13, 1993. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
